questions.stem: Using only NAND gates, implement the Boolean function $F = A + B$. How many NAND gates are required? Provide the answer as an integer.
questions.explanation: To implement $F = A + B$ using NAND gates, use De Morgan's theorem: $A + B = \overline{\overline{A} \cdot \overline{B}}$. This requires three NAND gates: two to create $\overline{A}$ and $\overline{B}$, and one more to combine them.
